lead.event: Bank Indonesia reserve-requirement cut and interest-rate decision
lead.headline: Bank Indonesia holds BI-Rate at 5.75% and cuts reserve requirements
lead.blurb: Reports estimate the reserve changes will release Rp90 trillion to Rp97 trillion in bank liquidity, while the Deposit Facility rate rises 25 basis points to 5%. BI said banks have flexibility over where to lend the funds, but must still commit to lending under its liquidity incentive policy. The changes will be phased in from 1 November and 1 December.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX suspension following PT Guna Timur Raya’s share surge
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX suspends TRUK after 87.1% weekly surge
market_structure_policy.blurb: Andry Hakim’s investment value rose from Rp9.3 billion to Rp131 billion, a gain of about Rp121 billion. Hakimson Growth Capital and Pukul Rata Kanan previously acquired a combined 20% stake at Rp428 per share, and Hakim says the pair have undisclosed plans and an agreement that could allow their ownership to increase.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from lead to story

capital_raising_buybacks.event: PT Visi Media Asia’s planned share issuance without pre-emptive rights
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: VIVA plans to issue up to 43.09 billion shares without pre-emptive rights
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Visi Media Asia would issue Series C shares to settle remaining Senior Facility debt. The exercise price would be the higher of Rp40 or the 25-day average closing price before the listing application, and existing shareholders could face dilution of up to 72.35%. Shareholders will vote on the plan on 17 November.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: PT Trimegah Karya Pratama’s planned private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: UVCR plans private placement of up to 200 million shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Ultra Voucher swung to operating profit of Rp10.35 billion in January–September 2026, from an operating loss of Rp275.9 million. Shareholders are due to vote on the placement at an extraordinary meeting on 27 October, with proceeds mainly for working capital, product and service development, operational capacity and marketing.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: regrouped, 1 of its articles moved out

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Mandiri reports nine-month 2026 earnings and broker target-price reactions
earnings_guidance.headline: BMRI reports Rp45.5 trillion nine-month profit as brokers set target prices
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Mandiri’s profit rose 20.7% year on year. Samuel Sekuritas maintained its buy rating and Rp4,900 target, implying 25.6% upside, while Sucor Sekuritas maintained hold and raised its target to Rp4,350.

earnings_guidance.headline: FORE reports 9M 2026 revenue up 53.3% to Rp1.6 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Fore Kopi Indonesia’s EBITDA rose 70.6% to Rp342.2 billion and net profit climbed 49.7% to Rp90 billion, Mandiri Sekuritas said, though profit was slightly below its expectations. The group added more than 70 Fore Coffee outlets, bringing its network to 410 stores across Indonesia and Singapore.

earnings_guidance.event: PT Sat Nusapersada H1 2026 revenue results and stock surge
earnings_guidance.headline: PTSN revenue rises 65.2% as shares gain 24.46%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Sat Nusapersada reported first-half revenue of US$182.28 million, while gross margin narrowed to 8.1% from 13.9% and profit before tax fell to US$6.13 million. The 23 October share move followed speculation the company could assemble or produce devices for a government plan to distribute free phones to at least 25 million adults, with a Rp27.61 trillion budget.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: On 23 October 2026, PTSN shares rose 24.46% to Rp346 amid speculation it could benefit from a government free-phone plan.

earnings_guidance.event: PT Trimegah Karya Pratama 9M 2026 net profit results
earnings_guidance.headline: UVCR reports 9M 2026 net profit of Rp10.63 billion, up 395.8%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Trimegah Karya Pratama's net sales rose 37.94% to Rp917.99 billion and gross profit climbed 56.47% to Rp44.5 billion. The company swung to operating profit of Rp10.36 billion from a loss of Rp275.91 million a year earlier.
